|notes=The [[Vader (V) (Virtual Set 10: Fourth Anthology) (Original 2005)|2005 original wording]] survives in the recovered publisher sheet. The remaster omits the explicit restriction to battle here. The period One Rule still limits the singular Interrupt substitution in a named battle to once per copy. The pilot bonus, Jedi modifiers and attrition immunity remain. [https://forum.starwarsccg.org/download/file.php?id=16603#page=1 Players Committee original sheet, p. 1, slip 12]. [[:File:VS10O-12-Vader.png|Publisher slip]]. [https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualCards10.pdf#page=2 Players Committee remastered sheet, p. 2, slip 12]. [https://web.archive.org/web/20090816063441id_/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/AR/AR1.7.1.pdf#page=21 Period One Rule].

The earlier associated [[:File:VS10O-08-Darth_Vaders_Lightsaber.png|collector 08 slip]] belongs to the separate lightsaber card.
